scope: 16 onboarding/controller acceptance scenarios, separate from 32 preserved sample/context cases.

tests.title: Missing installation
expected_checks: Show exact missing component, implementation owner and one next step.
No mailbox scan/activation claim.
forbidden_results: Ask user to repeat broad searches indefinitely.

tests.title: Wrong connection identity
expected_checks: Hold scope/audit; use correct approved user connection.
Keep profiles isolated.
forbidden_results: Read maker mailbox as if it belongs to user.

tests.title: All-history default
expected_checks: Enumerate approved folder hierarchy and all provider pages.
Recent preview remains explicitly incomplete while backfill runs.
forbidden_results: Silently reduce audit to top 10 or last 7 days.

tests.title: Empty page with continuation
expected_checks: Persist checkpoint and continue valid provider next page.

tests.title: Pause resume and duplicates
expected_checks: Resume committed checkpoint.
Deduplicate message/action and preserve source evidence.

tests.title: Full inventory with unreadable bodies
expected_checks: Show inventory complete and body gaps separately.
Hold affected work; no claim all bodies analyzed.

tests.title: Sent Items unavailable
expected_checks: Mark material context gap.
Hold dependent external follow-ups; a provisional read-only plan can still be shown.

tests.title: Profile corrects owner
expected_checks: Version corrected claim; invalidate dependent actions/approvals.

tests.title: Workflow edits after approval
expected_checks: Reject activation until exact new revision/hash approved.
Material coverage changes invalidate the dependent plan approval through coverage_version.
forbidden_results: Treat approval of v1 as approval of v2.

tests.title: Plan approval is not sending permission
expected_checks: Activate internal draft review only after controller gates.
No external send/mailbox write.

tests.title: Historical backlog
expected_checks: Create reviewed baseline queue; prioritize justified next actions.

tests.title: Draft and quoted history
expected_checks: Unsent draft is not approval.
Use current substantive evidence; preserve technical authority.

tests.title: Token revocation
expected_checks: Enter REAUTH_REQUIRED; pause affected work.
Preserve logs and reconcile before resume.
forbidden_results: Retry sends blindly under another identity.

tests.title: Scope change
expected_checks: Invalidate dependent audit/plan approvals; rerun affected scan.
forbidden_results: Reuse a plan approved for another mailbox/scope.

tests.title: Attachment metadata only
expected_checks: List file metadata but mark contents/version approval unverified.
Create internal verification/filing task if requested.

tests.title: Delta expiration and moved message
expected_checks: Resynchronize affected folder under approved scope.
Deduplicate immutable identity where supported; do not close obligation solely from move/deletion.
forbidden_results: Lose history or replay sent actions.
